blocks.label: Text: You appear to be in a season where faith is increasingly experienced as …
blocks.value: You appear to be in a season where faith is increasingly experienced as presence, freedom, compassion, and trust. You may feel less compelled to defend certainty and more drawn to recognize God in ordinary life and respond with love.

Heading: A Spiral, Not a Ladder
Text: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We receive, question, seek, rebuild, …
blocks.value: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We receive, question, seek, rebuild, embody, and awaken - often more than once. No stage is a rank, and no stage makes anyone more loved by God.

blocks.label: Text: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change - not God's…
blocks.value: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change - not God's relationship to us. Jesus remains at the center of the journey.

blocks.label: Heading: This is not arrival. It is availability.
blocks.value: This is not arrival. It is availability.

blocks.label: Text: You may be discovering that the deepest spiritual life is not dramatic. …
blocks.value: You may be discovering that the deepest spiritual life is not dramatic. It is the growing capacity to be here: awake to God, honest about reality, and available to the person or need in front of you.

blocks.label: Text: Contemplation and action are no longer competing paths. Stillness teache…
blocks.value: Contemplation and action are no longer competing paths. Stillness teaches you to see; love gives that seeing a body. One common risk is subtle spiritual superiority or detachment. The invitation is humility: remain teachable, embodied, connected, and willing to return to any earlier turn of the spiral.

blocks.label: Text: Awakening is less about reaching a distant God and more about becoming p…
blocks.value: Awakening is less about reaching a distant God and more about becoming present to the Presence already sustaining life.

blocks.label: Text: Stillness that is real gradually becomes compassion, courage, justice, a…
blocks.value: Stillness that is real gradually becomes compassion, courage, justice, and care.

blocks.label: Text: Freedom, mercy, humility, and care for the vulnerable reveal what is bec…
blocks.value: Freedom, mercy, humility, and care for the vulnerable reveal what is becoming real.

blocks.label: Text: Mature faith can revisit doubt, grief, and rebuilding without shame. No …
blocks.value: Mature faith can revisit doubt, grief, and rebuilding without shame. No one graduates from being human.

blocks.label: Text: A Practice for This Season
Text: Present to God. Available to love.
blocks.value: Present to God. Available to love.

blocks.label: Text: Feel your feet, breath, and body. Let yourself be here.
blocks.value: Feel your feet, breath, and body. Let yourself be here.

blocks.label: Text: Breathe in the truth that you are already held in love.
blocks.value: Breathe in the truth that you are already held in love.

blocks.label: Text: Open your senses to what is present without judging or fixing it.
blocks.value: Open your senses to what is present without judging or fixing it.

blocks.label: Text: Ask quietly, “Jesus, what does love invite now?”
blocks.value: Ask quietly, “Jesus, what does love invite now?”

blocks.label: Text: Name one person, place, or task and become available to love there.
blocks.value: Name one person, place, or task and become available to love there.

blocks.label: Text: The aim is not a special experience. It is a more available life.
blocks.value: The aim is not a special experience. It is a more available life.

blocks.label: Heading: Try this for seven days.
Text: Begin with five quiet minutes, then carry one phrase into the next perso…
blocks.value: Begin with five quiet minutes, then carry one phrase into the next person or task before you.

blocks.value: Choose one companion that helps awareness become humility, courage, and love in action.

blocks.value: A classic invitation into contemplation as life fully awake and receptive to God.

blocks.value: Living Awake is not a private achievement. Presence is protected and deepened through people who help us remain honest, grounded, and available to love.

blocks.label: Text: Homeward Circles are places to practice this way of life: sharing a meal…
blocks.value: Homeward Circles are places to practice this way of life: sharing a meal, listening beneath the surface, sitting with Jesus and Scripture, and helping one another carry love into the world.

blocks.label: Text: No one arrives alone. We become awake in relationship.
